data.title: Contribution notice for voluntary health insurance from June 2026
data.summary: Allgemeine Musterkasse sets your voluntary health and long-term care insurance contributions at €530.85 per month from 1 June 2026. The letter is dated 21 May 2026.
data.explanation: This is a contribution decision (Beitragsbescheid) for your voluntary membership. Health insurance is €412.65 and long-term care insurance (Pflegeversicherung) is €118.20, so €530.85 per month in total. The amount is collected by direct debit on the 15th of the following month, so make sure your account is covered. If you think the amount is wrong, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing, electronically or in person at the insurer. The app shows the deadline. If unsure, consider getting advice.
data.tax_note: Health and long-term care insurance contributions can be deductible as special expenses (Sonderausgaben) in your tax return.

items.title: Objection against contribution notice

date.text: Die Frist dafür beträgt einen Monat ab Bekanntgabe

items.action: If you disagree, file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing, electronically or on record with Allgemeine Musterkasse.
items.consequence: After the deadline the notice becomes final.
items.quote: Die Frist dafür beträgt einen Monat ab Bekanntgabe; der Widerspruch ist schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift bei der Allgemeinen Musterkasse, Gesundheitsplatz 5, 30159 Musterstadt, zu erheben.

items.title: Monthly health and care insurance contribution
items.action: Keep enough money in your account for the direct debit on the 15th of the following month.
items.quote: Die Beiträge werden jeweils zum 15. des Folgemonats per Lastschrift eingezogen.
